articles.title: UNILAG Releases 2026/2027 Merit Admission Cut-Off Marks Across All Faculties
articles.excerpt: The University of Lagos (UNILAG) Central Admissions Committee has officially published the aggregate merit cut-off marks for all undergraduate degree programmes for the 2026/2027 academic session.
articles.content:
Official Merit Cut-Off Marks for 2026/2027 Undergraduate Admissions

The management of the University of Lagos (UNILAG), Akoka, has officially released the departmental merit admission cut-off scores for all undergraduate programmes across the institution's twelve faculties.

Prospective candidates who sat for the 2026 Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (UTME) and successfully participated in the UNILAG online post-UTME screening can now verify their aggregate scores against their chosen courses.

Faculty Highlights & Top Programmes:

  • College of Medicine: Medicine & Surgery pegged at 84.625 aggregate; Nursing Science at 77.125; Pharmacy at 78.375.
  • Faculty of Engineering: Computer Engineering at 81.25; Electrical & Electronics at 79.5; Mechanical Engineering at 77.875.
  • Faculty of Law: Aggregate cut-off finalized at 79.875 for Law.
  • Faculty of Management Sciences: Accounting cut-off set at 76.5; Finance at 73.25.

Candidates are strongly advised to regularly check their JAMB Central Admission Processing System (CAPS) profile to monitor the transition from 'Recommended' to 'Approved' status.

articles.title: JAMB CAPS 2026/2027 Portal Active: Step-by-Step Guide to Check and Accept Admission
articles.excerpt: The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) has fully activated the 2026 Central Admission Processing System (CAPS) portal. Here is how to verify and accept your admission status on mobile or desktop.
articles.content:
JAMB CAPS Portal Activated for 2026/2027 Admission Cycle

The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) has notified all candidates and participating higher education institutions that the Central Admission Processing System (CAPS) is now live and actively processing recommendations.

Candidates must understand that admission offers made by individual universities, polytechnics, or colleges of education are only officially recognized when processed and approved through JAMB CAPS.

How to Check Your Admission Status on JAMB CAPS:

  1. Visit the official JAMB eFacility portal at portal.jamb.gov.ng/efacility.
  2. Log in using your registered email address and password.
  3. Ensure your mobile browser is switched to Desktop Site mode for full dashboard access.
  4. Click on Check Admission Status, select your exam year, and click Access My CAPS.
  5. Click on Admission Status on the left-hand navigation panel.
  6. If offered admission, click Accept Admission. Do not reject unless you are 100% certain you do not want the offer.

articles.title: NNPC/TotalEnergies National Merit Scholarship 2026: Application Portal Now Open
articles.excerpt: The NNPC/TotalEnergies E&P Nigeria Limited Joint Venture invites applications from qualified full-time registered 100-level and 200-level Nigerian undergraduates across all accredited universities.
articles.content:
NNPC / TotalEnergies National Merit Scholarship Scheme 2026

The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) in partnership with TotalEnergies E&P Nigeria Limited announces the commencement of online applications for its prestigious National Merit Scholarship scheme for the 2026/2027 academic session.

This award provides substantial annual financial grants to successful Nigerian undergraduate students until the completion of their degree courses.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Must be a registered full-time undergraduate student in an accredited Nigerian university.
  • Currently in 100-level or 200-level at the time of application.
  • Must possess a minimum of 5 credits in SSCE/WASSCE/NECO including English Language and Mathematics at one sitting.
  • Minimum CGPA of 3.50 on a 5.0 scale (or equivalent) for 200-level applicants.

Applications are strictly online and free of charge. Beware of touts or fraudulent third-party portals requesting money for submissions.

articles.title: University of Ibadan (UI) Announces 2026/2027 Post-UTME Screening Dates and Cut-Off Points
articles.excerpt: The University of Ibadan has officially invited candidates who selected UI as their first choice institution in the 2026 UTME and scored 200 and above to apply for the computer-based screening.
articles.content:
University of Ibadan 2026/2027 Post-UTME Screening Announcement

Nigeria's premier university, the University of Ibadan (UI), has officially opened its admission screening portal for candidates seeking admission into various undergraduate degree programmes for the 2026/2027 session.

Eligible candidates who chose the University of Ibadan as their first choice in the 2026 UTME and scored a minimum of 200 aggregate marks are advised to complete their biometric and biodata registration on the UI admissions portal.

Key Screening Requirements:

  • Minimum UTME score of 200 in the 2026 JAMB examination.
  • Five credit passes at one sitting or six credits at two sittings in relevant O'Level subjects.
  • Direct Entry candidates must have registered through JAMB and possess genuine ND, HND, NCE, or Cambridge A-Level certificates.

articles.title: WAEC Releases Official 2026 May/June WASSCE Timetable and Biometric Verification Guidelines
articles.excerpt: The West African Examinations Council has unveiled the comprehensive timetable for the 2026 West African Senior School Certificate Examination (WASSCE) for school candidates.
articles.content:
WAEC 2026 May/June WASSCE Timetable and Council Directives

The West African Examinations Council (WAEC) Nigeria National Office has officially published the approved timetable for the 2026 West African Senior School Certificate Examination (WASSCE) for school candidates.

The council emphasized that all registered schools must strictly implement the updated biometric identity capturing system to eradicate examination malpractice and identity impersonation in exam halls.

Examination Guidelines & Deadlines:

  • Practical examinations commence across all accredited secondary schools nationwide from early May.
  • General paper theories follow according to the synchronized West African regional schedule.
  • Principals and examination officers must ensure all candidate passport photographs comply with the digital specification.

articles.title: NUC Grants Full Accreditation to 24 New Degree Programmes Across Federal and State Universities
articles.excerpt: The National Universities Commission (NUC) has approved full accreditation for twenty-four newly evaluated undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes across Nigeria.
articles.content:
NUC Releases Comprehensive 2026 Accreditation Bulletin

The National Universities Commission (NUC) has released the results of its institutional resource verification and programme accreditation exercise carried out in late 2025.

A total of 24 degree programmes in emerging academic domains—including Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Biomedical Engineering, and Data Science—have been awarded full accreditation status.

Notable Approvals:

  • Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA): Full accreditation for B.Tech Cybersecurity and Data Analytics.
  • Ahmadu Bello University (ABU), Zaria: Re-accredited Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Software Engineering.
  • University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN): Full clearance for Mechatronics Engineering.

articles.title: Top Nigerian Commercial Banks Open 2026 Graduate Trainee Recruitment: Eligibility & Assessment Structure
articles.excerpt: Major financial institutions including Access Bank, Zenith Bank, and GTBank have declared open applications for their 2026 Entry-Level and Graduate Trainee programmes.
articles.content:
2026 Graduate Trainee Openings in Nigerian Financial Sector

Recent Nigerian graduates who completed their National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) with a minimum of Second Class Upper (2:1) can now apply for top tier commercial banking trainee academies.

The programmes offer rigorous fast-track leadership development, cross-departmental rotations, and competitive entry packages.

General Requirements:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree (Second Class Upper) in any discipline from an accredited tertiary institution.
  • Completion of the mandatory NYSC discharge certificate or official letter of exemption.
  • Maximum age of 26 years as of December 2026.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and digital literacy skills.

articles.title: Meet OAU's Record-Breaking Graduate Who Finished With 4.98 CGPA in Chemical Engineering
articles.excerpt: In an exclusive interview with LegitSchoolGists, 22-year-old Adeola Balogun shares the study habits, time management routines, and mindset that propelled him to near-perfect academic glory at Obafemi Awolowo University.
articles.content:
Academic Excellence Spotlight: Adeola Balogun

Finishing at the peak of one of Africa's most intellectually rigorous engineering faculties, Adeola Balogun has set a multi-year academic benchmark at Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU), Ile-Ife.

With an astounding Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 4.98 out of 5.0, Adeola cleared virtually every course with an 'A' grade across all five years of study.

Core Study Secrets & Advice for Nigerian Undergraduates:

"Consistency beats last-minute cramming every single semester. I treated every test like the final examination and made sure I mastered previous question styles two weeks before lecture ends."
  • Study during high-alert morning hours rather than all-night exhaustion.
  • Form collaborative study groups with goal-driven peers.
  • Never hesitate to approach academic advisors and departmental professors for mentorship.

articles.title: NELFUND Expands Student Loan Portal with Immediate Monthly Maintenance Stipends for Enrolled Students
articles.excerpt: The Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) has completed the integration of its upgraded digital portal, enabling automatic verification with JAMB matriculation lists and swift disbursement of monthly allowances.
articles.content:
NELFUND Upgrades Student Support Architecture

The Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) has announced substantial operational improvements to its digital lending platform, making access easier for thousands of eligible Nigerian undergraduates.

Under the revised directives of the Federal Government, tuition fees are remitted directly to the candidate's respective university or polytechnic treasury, while maintenance stipends of ₦20,000 monthly are disbursed straight to the student’s bank account.

Application Steps on NELFUND Portal:

  1. Navigate to nelf.gov.ng.
  2. Register with your National Identification Number (NIN), Bank Verification Number (BVN), and JAMB Registration Number.
  3. Verify institutional details and course of study.
  4. Submit the digital application for immediate processing.
